title: Choose Lean — more Figure
question: Still rear-view rider. Three more: the number lives on the bike, the view is onboard, or you are orange.

options.label: Plate
options.thesis: The number plate is the readout. 32° is on the bike, not floating in the plaque.
options.viewport: Square plaque. White rear-view MX rider leaned 32°. The rear number plate is an orange skew plaque that reads 32°. Bars orange for steer. Small 30% under the plate.
options.risk: A plate can read as a race number, not degrees, unless the ° is loud.

options.label: Onboard
options.thesis: Camera a little above and behind, like an onboard. Lean is weight on a peg, not a side-on toy.
options.viewport: Square plaque. White MX rider from above-behind, leaned right, right peg loaded orange. Orange 32° in the lower-left of the glass. Small 30% near the bars.
options.risk: Overhead can look like a minimap bike if the helmet isn’t obvious.

options.label: You
options.thesis: Orange is you. The rider is Holeshot Orange, the bike stays white. Lean is the orange body.
options.viewport: Square plaque. Rear-view: white MX bike, orange rider leaned 32°. White ExtraBold Italic 32° under the bike. Steer as the white bar angle. Spectate could dim the rider to white.
options.risk: A fully orange rider can turn into a blob at HUD scale.
